vocab.definition: monomers join and a small molecule is lost.
usually water, lost each time monomers join.
each monomer reacts at both ends.
a condensation polymer (e.g. from a diol + diacid).

misconceptions.right: It makes the polymer AND a small molecule (water).

misconceptions.wrong: It uses one type of monomer with a C=C.
misconceptions.right: It uses monomers with two functional groups each.

misconceptions.wrong: Addition and condensation are the same.
misconceptions.right: Condensation loses a small molecule; addition does not.

infoPanels.title: ADDITION vs CONDENSATION
workedSteps: A small molecule (water) is lost each join.

questions.text: State what is meant by condensation polymerisation. [1 mark]

footer.tip: Condensation = two monomers join AND a small molecule (water) is released.
footer.thinkPrompt: Why can a single C=C monomer not make a condensation polymer?
